cohort: 660 pregnant women in Indonesia who sought care at obstetrics clinics from January 2023 to March 2023
finding: A risk prediction model for SUI in pregnant women was developed and internally validated, demonstrating good discrimination (AUROC 0.787) and incorporating BMI during pregnancy, constipation, and previous delivery mode as predictors.
mod_finding: Previous mode of delivery was a predictive factor for stress urinary incontinence in pregnant women.
